run_benchmark_iterating: run the benchmark_iterating function to measure dataset iteration speed across different read methods
run_read_benchmark: run the read function to benchmark single example access on a HuggingFace dataset
run_read_batch_benchmark: run the read_batch function to benchmark batched access on a HuggingFace dataset
run_read_formatted_benchmark: run the read_formatted function to benchmark formatted single example access using numpy, pandas, torch, or tensorflow
run_read_formatted_batch_benchmark: run the read_formatted_batch function to benchmark formatted batched access on a HuggingFace dataset
